Composite Fluorescence Images from Channel Fields

Source: R/figure-data-images.R
CompositeFields.Rd

Turns image fields (lists with a channels element of named matrices, as returned by segmantR::sg_read_field()) into RGB images for galleries: every view is an additive mixture of display-scaled channels, clip((value - lo) / (hi - lo), 0, 1) ^ gamma * weight * colour.

Usage

CompositeFields(
  fields,
  views,
  slide = NULL,
  levels = NULL,
  source = "source",
  gamma = 0.8,
  min_span = 1,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

fields

List of fields (channels, and row with the field's table row for column lookups).

views

Named list of views; each view is a list of layers.

slide, levels

Optional data frames with columns channel, lo, hi and, when fields come from several images, source.

source

Column of a field's row that matches source in the range tables.

gamma

Display gamma.

min_span

Minimum distance between the levels.

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object (resolves colour names).

Value

A list of class phenoscapR_images with images (list of RGB arrays) and info (data frame: image, field, view and the columns of each field's row).

Details

A layer is a list with channel (a channel name) or column (a column of the field's row table that holds the channel name), colour (hex or style colour), optional weight (default 1), overlay (paint over the mixture instead of adding) and display levels: lo and hi. lo is the name of a range table ("slide", "levels") or "q0.01" (a quantile of the field's own values); hi is one or several terms, each a table name, a table name with a factor ("slide*0.9") or a quantile ("q0.995"); the largest term is used, and never less than lo + min_span.

Examples

set.seed(1)
field <- list(channels = list(dna = matrix(runif(100, 0, 50), 10),
                              cd3 = matrix(runif(100, 0, 20), 10)))
views <- list(merge = list(list(channel = "dna", colour = "#3366FF", lo = "q0", hi = "q0.99"),
                           list(channel = "cd3", colour = "#FF3300", lo = "q0.5", hi = "q1")))
imgs <- CompositeFields(field, views)
dim(imgs$images[[1]])
#> [1] 10 10  3
imgs$info
#>   image field  view field_name
#> 1     1     1 merge          1
